BrunoScript_BrunoBeforeText:
I am BRUNO of the
ELITE FOUR.

I always train to
the extreme be- cause I believe in our potential.

That is how we
became strong.

Can you withstand
our power?

Hm? I see no fear
in you. You look

determined. Per-
fect for battle!

Ready, {PLAYER}?
You will bow down

to our overwhelm-
ing power!

Hoo hah!
BrunoScript_BrunoDefeatText:
Having lost, I
have no right to say anything…

Go face your next
challenge!
